about_me_p1: Hi, my name is Verónica Clavijo (<0>Vero</0> or <1>Veuge</1>). I have been working as a developer since 2017, mostly on projects for clients in the United States and Europe. I work mainly with JavaScript, React and React Native, and I'm on my way to becoming a Fullstack developer.
about_me_p2: Welcome to my <0>digital garden</0>! Here I'll write about what I learn day to day, my personal projects and other miscellaneous things. Nothing here is final: everything is constantly evolving, and I'll keep updating the content as it does.

whoami_p1: Hello, hello! My name is Verónica Clavijo (you can call me <0>Vero</0>, which is shorter and friendlier, or <1>Veuge</1>, the <2>clever</2> abbreviation of my two names: Verónica Eugenia).
whoami_p2: I started working as a developer in 2017, almost immediately after graduating from university with a degree in Computer Science and no experience in software development. I began as what they called a <0>ghost dev</0>: I made commits on behalf of a teammate until I earned my own place on the team xD. I've worked on many projects since then, starting with ExtJS, React and React Native, and currently Node.js and Express, which is great because I had been wanting to become a Fullstack developer for several years.
